name: @taurean/suede-css
description: a starter set of CSS files
author: Taurean Bryant <cya@L8R.email>

scripts.release:patch: pnpm lint && pnpm check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && pnpm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags && pnpm publish --access=public --publish-branch main
scripts.release:minor: pnpm lint && pnpm check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && pnpm version minor && git push origin main --follow-tags && pnpm publish --access=public --publish-branch main
scripts.release:major: pnpm lint && pnpm check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && pnpm version major && git push origin main --follow-tags && pnpm publish --access=public --publish-branch main
